Good — FIX_LEDGER.md and PROGRESS.md left in the working tree for the runner's auto-commit, exactly matching the CP-15 precedent. My CP-16 code commit (`b925851`) is clean and isolated.

**Summary:**
- Fixed CP-16a (PPT SVG diagrams now rasterize to real PNG via `svgCodeToPngBytes` before `addImage`, at both call sites in `src/lib/ppt/generator.ts`, with a caption-placeholder fallback on rasterization failure) and CP-16b (`sanitizeForPDF` in `src/lib/pdf/builder.ts` now substitutes a visible `'?'` for unrenderable Unicode instead of silently deleting it, with a warning log) — committed locally as `b925851`, not pushed (session default).
- Verified with a new `_cp_16_verify/verify.ts` harness (16 assertions): real PNG magic-number bytes and `file`-confirmed PNG media inside an unzipped `.pptx`; the exact Devanagari+emoji+logic-symbol+café stress string surviving as visible placeholders; plus unhappy-path coverage (malformed SVG → `null` fallback, concurrent rasterization calls not cross-contaminating). `tsc`/`eslint`/`build` all clean.
- Along the way, cleared 8 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` lint errors in the two touched files (blocking the commit guard) with zero behavior change, and found/reverted an unrelated stray one-line corruption in root `CLAUDE.md` that predated this session. `.claude/PROGRESS.md` and `.claude/FIX_LEDGER.md` are updated in the working tree, left uncommitted for the runner's own auto-commit, matching CP-15's precedent.

tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
CP-16: PPT SVG fallback rasterization + Notes PDF Unicode substitution

16a: generator.ts's SVG-diagram fallback (both the main diagram-slide path
and the dual_visual right-panel path) rasterized raw SVG to a real PNG via
svgCodeToPngBytes before addImage. Previously pptxgenjs wrote SVG bytes into
a media part it labeled image/png, so every SVG-diagram slide shipped a
mislabeled file. On rasterization failure, falls back to the same
caption-placeholder treatment already used for a failed mermaid render
(marks _needsReview instead of crashing or shipping bad bytes). Removed the
now-unused svgToBase64 helper.

16b: builder.ts's sanitizeForPDF catch-all now substitutes a visible '?'
placeholder for any character outside the Helvetica-renderable ASCII range,
instead of silently deleting it — matching the convention already used in
qpaper/builder.ts's sanitize(). Logs a warning per substitution so silent
data loss in a generated PDF is now visible in server logs too.

Verified via _cp_16_verify/verify.ts (16 assertions, all passing): real
rasterized PNG bytes carry the PNG magic number and unzip from a real .pptx
as `file`-detected PNG (not SVG); malformed/unparseable SVG rasterizes to
null on the fallback path rather than crashing; two concurrent rasterization
calls don't cross-contaminate; the Devanagari+emoji+logic-symbol+café stress
string from FIX_SPEC.md survives as visible '?' placeholders, not silent
deletion; existing curated-allowlist substitutions (π, ≥, ∞, →, ²) are
unaffected. tsc/eslint/build clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
